$comment: Generated by 'spectool render' from vectors/payload/constructed.yaml - do not edit.
description: Constructed payload vectors for the two validation modes of MG 8 (SF-052): strict validation reports every key that is not defined for the object (REQ-MSG-001, conformance of the sender), tolerant validation ignores such keys (REQ-MSG-046, view of a tolerant receiver). Without mode a vector is checked strictly. Since C-027 also invalid variants of golden vectors that each violate one rule of the resource content checks (Health, Pagination, MAM, PublicationList; since C-028 Event, Oi4Pv, SubscriptionList and Get Metadata; since C-029 Config; since C-035 the MetaData objects of MG 8.2.2 … 8.2.15). Since C-035 also messages with a declared role (field role: Birth, Close, Will; Q-020 (a)).

vectors.title: Pub Health with user-defined keys, strict validation
vectors.reason: The NetworkMessage and the DataSetMessage contain the user-defined key VendorTag.
vectors.notes: V-PAY-003 with the user-defined keys VendorTag in the NetworkMessage and in the DataSetMessage: a sender must not add them (REQ-MSG-001).

vectors.title: Pub Health with user-defined keys, tolerant validation
vectors.notes: The message of V-PAY-018 seen by a tolerant receiver: the unknown keys are ignored and the defined keys are valid (REQ-MSG-046).

vectors.title: Pub Health with a HealthScore above 100

vectors.notes: V-PAY-003 with HealthScore 101 (MG 8.3.2: 0 … 100).

vectors.title: Pub Health whose Health does not reflect the Detail with the highest priority
vectors.reason: Health is NORMAL_0 although a Detail reports FAILURE_1.
vectors.notes: V-PAY-003 with two Details, one of them FAILURE_1: the overall Health reflects the state with the highest priority of the Details (MG 8.3.2, order FAILURE_1 > CHECK_FUNCTION_2 > OFF_SPEC_3 > MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED_4 > NORMAL_0).

vectors.title: Pub Metadata with structure, enumeration and simple data types
vectors.notes: Self-initialized Pub Metadata (ReplyTo "") of the publisher-defined Data DataSet axis of the field data service (Source = the application, Filter = WriterGroupName axis). The DataSet uses three vendor data types of the namespace http://vendor.com/UA/ (NodeIds and QualifiedNames in the nsu= form, REQ-MSG-039): the structure Range (StructureType Structure_0, two scalar Double fields), the enumeration AxisMode (BuiltInType 6, Int64 Values as JSON strings, DisplayName as LocalizedText) and the simple type Percent (based on Double). Without DataSetClassId (publisher- defined DataSet, REQ-MSG-012 "may"). Constructed because no guideline example shows a filled StructureDataTypes, EnumDataTypes or SimpleDataTypes.

vectors.title: Predefined MetaData of ReferenceDesignation without DataSetClassId

vectors.notes: V-PAY-017 (MG B2) without the DataSetClassId 27a75019-164a-496d-a38b-90e8a55c2cfa. A bare DataSetMetaDataType is the predefined MetaData of the resource named by Name (MG B2, SF-054).

vectors.title: Pub Metadata without Timestamp

vectors.notes: V-PAY-152 without Timestamp.

vectors.title: Pub Metadata with a numeric StructureType

vectors.notes: V-PAY-152 whose StructureDefinition has StructureType 0. The numeric value violates the VerboseEncoding of the MetaData (REQ-MSG-034) and is no value of EnumStructureType (REQ-MSG-042), as for the enumerations of the resources (V-PAY-145).

vectors.title: Pub Metadata without the empty EnumDataTypes

vectors.notes: V-PAY-121 without the empty array EnumDataTypes.

vectors.title: Pub Metadata with an incomplete ConfigurationVersion

vectors.title: Pub Metadata with the BuiltInType as name

vectors.title: Pub Metadata with two fields of the same name

vectors.title: Pub Metadata with a NodeId in the namespace index form

vectors.title: Pub Metadata with a Description without Locale

vectors.title: Pub Metadata with an unknown StructureType

vectors.title: Pub Metadata with an enumeration value as JSON number

vectors.title: Pub Metadata with a SimpleTypeDescription without BaseDataType

vectors.title: Will message with Health NORMAL_0

vectors.notes: V-PAY-025 with the Health of a Close message (NORMAL_0). Valid as a regular Pub Health; invalid with the declared role will (rule layer R-6).

vectors.title: Will message with HealthScore 10
vectors.reason: A Will message carries Health FAILURE_1 and HealthScore 0 (MG 6.3.5).
vectors.notes: V-PAY-025 with HealthScore 10. Valid as a regular Pub Health; invalid with the declared role will (rule layer R-6).

vectors.title: Call with a ResponseAddress of the Method Pub

vectors.title: Call with the Reply topic of another application as ResponseAddress

vectors.title: Call with ActionState 2

vectors.notes: V-PAY-008 with the ActionState of a final response.

vectors.title: Call without RequestId

vectors.notes: V-PAY-008 whose ActionRequest has no RequestId.

vectors.title: Reply with ActionState 0

vectors.title: Call NewDataSetWriterId for an unknown Resource

vectors.title: Reply NewDataSetWriterId without Ttl

vectors.title: Reply NewDataSetWriterId rejected with BadInvalidArgument

vectors.title: Pub MAM whose ProductInstanceUri does not match its ProductCode
vectors.reason: A generated Oi4Identifier is built from ManufacturerUri, Model, ProductCode and SerialNumber of the MAM (MG 4.3.1).
vectors.notes: V-PAY-028 with the ProductCode FDS-002, while the ProductInstanceUri (and AppId) is the generated Oi4Identifier with FDS-001. Checked by the rule layer of D7 validate (ADR-0019 §5, R-3), heuristically: only a ProductInstanceUri without scheme of four segments whose first segment is the ManufacturerUri is taken for a generated Oi4Identifier.

vectors.title: Pub MAM whose ProductInstanceUri differs from the DataSetWriterName
vectors.reason: The ProductInstanceUri equals the Oi4Identifier in the DataSetWriterName.
vectors.notes: V-PAY-028 with a different ProductInstanceUri. The equality of two fields is checked by the rule layer of D7 validate (ADR-0019 §5, R-3).

vectors.title: Pub MAM with a ProductInstanceUri of 256 characters
vectors.reason: The ProductInstanceUri has at most 255 characters.
vectors.notes: V-PAY-029 (Pub MAM without Source) for an asset whose ProductInstanceUri and DataSetWriterName have 256 characters.

vectors.title: Pub MAM of an OT connector with the DeviceClass Oi4.Utility
vectors.reason: The DeviceClass of an OEC application is Oi4.<ServiceType> of its own ServiceType.
vectors.notes: V-PAY-028 (MAM of the application itself) with the DeviceClass of a Utility. The equality with the ServiceType of the topic is checked by the rule layer of D7 validate (ADR-0019 §5, R-2).

vectors.title: Pub PublicationList entry with an unencoded Filter
vectors.reason: The Filter of an entry is topic-encoded; a '+' is encoded as %2B (MG 8.3.8, MG 7.7).
vectors.notes: V-PAY-037 with the Tag o+e unencoded in the Filter (the WriterGroupName repeats it, so only the encoding is wrong), on the topic without list filter (the topic Filter would be Data/o%2Be).

vectors.title: Pub PublicationList with the same entry twice
vectors.reason: Resource, Source and Filter identify an entry; they are unique within the publisher (MG 8.3.8).
vectors.notes: V-PAY-037 with its entry repeated. JSON Schema cannot compare items by a key; rule layer (R-3).

vectors.title: Set PublicationList without entry

vectors.title: Pub Health with an encoded Identification Link in the ReplyTo
vectors.reason: Identification Links in the payload are not encoded (MG 4.2); the ReplyTo carries the base64url form of the requestor's IL.
vectors.notes: V-PAY-003 whose ReplyTo names the sender ITConnector/aHR0cHM6Ly9pZC5jb25zdW1lci5jb20vTUVTZXJ2aWNlL0luc3QwNzMyMg, the topic encoding of https://id.consumer.com/MEService/Inst07322. The oracle detects an encoded IL heuristically: the value is no valid IL but its base64url decoding is (C-040).

vectors.title: Call with an encoded Identification Link in RequestorId and MessageId
vectors.reason: Identification Links in the payload are not encoded (MG 4.2); RequestorId and MessageId carry the base64url form of the requestor's IL.
vectors.notes: V-PAY-008 whose RequestorId and MessageId use the topic encoding of https://id.consumer.com/MEService/Inst07322. MessageId and RequestorId still agree, so REQ-ACT-004 holds; only REQ-IL-005 is violated (twice).

vectors.title: Pub Health with all Identification Links unencoded
vectors.notes: The message of V-PAY-003: PublisherId, MessageId, ReplyTo and DataSetWriterName carry the Identification Links unencoded, the topic carries them encoded (MG 4.2).

vectors.title: Pub MAM whose generated Oi4Identifier has an unmasked reserved character
vectors.reason: The elements of a generated Oi4Identifier are dnp-encoded (REQ-IL-033, SF-104): the SerialNumber ABC@home is ABC,40home.
vectors.notes: Drafted in C-046 addendum 2 after the PO decision on SF-104 (MG 4.1 governs, the masking is mandatory). V-PAY-210 as the MAM of an asset with the SerialNumber ABC@home; ProductInstanceUri and DataSetWriterName carry it unmasked. "@" is permitted in an Identification Link, so only the Oi4Identifier rule is violated; REQ-IL-033 itself is manual, D7 checks it through the heuristic of REQ-RES-MAM-006 (ADR-0019 §5, R-3). Valid with provider.com/FieldDataService/FDS-001/ABC,40home.
